newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan budget decision will come after GDP data-EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan budget decision will come after GDP data-EPA.

text.p: The Japanese government will decide whether to draft a supplementary budget for 1996/97 depending on the results of the April-June gross domestic product data due out later this month, Japan's Economic Planning Agency Minister Shusei Tanaka told a news conference on Tuesday.
Tanaka also said that today's earlier stock market fall was the result of a variety of factors, citing U.S.-Iraqi tensions in particular.
He said a possible delay in a decision to draft an extra budget was not the main factor. "If the supplementary budget is delayed, then this would mean that the tone of the economy is strong.
"Rather it is the result of worries over Middle East tension," he said.
He said that while stock movements were decided by the market, he would closely watch future movements.
